name: RoofGS
definition: RoofGS is an end-to-end acceleration method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that organizes the rendering pipeline according to a stage-specific optimization principle: bandwidth-limited stages prioritize reductions in global memory traffic, whereas compute-intensive stages prioritize lower instruction cost and increased instruction-level parallelism (ILP).
summary: RoofGS is an end-to-end acceleration method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses the Roofline model to apply stage-specific hardware optimizations, distinguishing itself by simultaneously reducing memory traffic and enhancing instruction-level parallelism.
